<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import csv

def main():
    df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv')
    
    # Pivot long-format data to wide-format matrix
    pivot_df = df.pivot(
        index=['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'],
        columns='indicator_id',
        values='value'
    )
    
    # Flatten the index back into regular columns
    pivot_df = pivot_df.reset_index()
    pivot_df.columns.name = None
    
    # Ensure identifier columns come first, followed by indicator columns
    id_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
    other_cols = [c for c in pivot_df.columns if c not in id_cols]
    pivot_df = pivot_df[id_cols + other_cols]
    
    # Write output with RFC 4180 compliant quoting
    pivot_df.to_csv(
        'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv',
        index=False,
        quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL
    )

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
</solution_file>
